## Description {#details}

<p>This node is the base class for sequential/in-order min/max selections.</p>


<p>Note that their fundamental difference from <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/scevminmaxexpr">SCEVMinMaxExpr</a>'s is that they are early-returning upon reaching saturation point. I.e. given <span class="doxyComputerOutput">0 umin_seq poison</span>, the result will be <span class="doxyComputerOutput">0</span>, while the result of <span class="doxyComputerOutput">0 umin poison</span> is <span class="doxyComputerOutput">poison</span>. When returning early, later expressions are not executed, so <span class="doxyComputerOutput">0 umin_seq (x u/ 0)</span> does not result in undefined behavior.</p>


<p>Definition at line 517 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/analysis/scalarevolutionexpressions-h">ScalarEvolutionExpressions.h</a>.</p>
